snippet.title: Guardians Planetfall - Official Gameplay Trailer | Upload VR Showcase Winter 2025
snippet.description: From the creators of Guardians Frontline, Guardians Planetfall drops you into a galaxy-wide war for the fate of humanity. Watch the Guardians Planetfall trailer for this upcomin tactical VR game. Fight assembled into squads of up to 4 soldiers in fast, tactical VR combat across dangerous procedural planets and space installations filled with hostile Aliens, Void soldiers, and massive war machines. Guardians Planetfall will be available in Early Access on the Meta Quest Store and Steam VR in 2026.
